text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the Minor Maintenance Procedures P2, which must be performed every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title block.
Safety Precautions
Circuit breaker isolation and earthing is required.
A work permit must be issued.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes etc
Change remote/ local control switch to local position.
Tools and Equipment
MultiMate, blower, gas detector, buzzer screwdriver and set of common keys.
Work to be Carried Out
1. | Check supply voltage.
2. | Check screw joints of the electric connections by pulling, retighten, if necessary.
3. | Check pull-reliefs at cables
4. | Check mechanical connections at drive or auxiliary switch by visual control
for tightness and wear.
5 | Check mechanical position indicator and adjustment of linkages (shown setting values at the individual poles must agree with each other).
6 | Check springs and springs suspension.
7 | Check stop in the correct position.
8 | Check density of shaft seal in housing cover
9 | Check functioning of auxiliary switch contacts (current passage test, switching in the end positions).
10 | Check contact penetration depth. Rated value max 110 mm/min
102 mm until touching /separation oh contacts stroke of switch rod : 122 2
mm
11 | Check wear of annular contacts and switch rod 
1) 2)
12 | Execute test-switching operations.
13 | Check the number of rotation (manual operation)
14 | Check electrical position signals (position indicator )
15 | Check running time of drive. Compare with reference values
from commissioning.
Note: | 1) Requires opening of the gas compartment.
2) Random test at equipment having under gone highest load.
